standout_highlights.title: Feeling unwell but streaming
standout_highlights.description: Iron Mouse reveals she is 'sick' but is committed to streaming today despite not feeling okay, confirming it will be a short stream.

standout_highlights.title: Waiting for Rob for IRL stream
standout_highlights.description: Mouse mentions she's waiting for Rob to message her so they can start an IRL stream.

standout_highlights.title: Front row seats for 10 alive concert
standout_highlights.description: She excitingly shares that she has obtained front-row seats for the '10 alive' concert.

standout_highlights.title: Positive review of yesterday's concert
standout_highlights.description: Iron Mouse reflects on how 'really good' yesterday's concert was.

standout_highlights.title: Temporary departure for testing
standout_highlights.description: Mouse announces she needs to take a short break to test something, promising to return soon and asking viewers not to leave.

standout_highlights.title: Return to Warframe & Clan Invitation
standout_highlights.description: Mouse acknowledges that a viewer (M) was instrumental in pulling their 'soul back into Warframe' and receives an invitation to join a clan.

standout_highlights.title: Skinny Legend Joke
standout_highlights.description: Mouse playfully claims to be a 'skinny legend' so thin that 'they didn't see me there,' joking about being 'as thin as a stick' due to a diet.

standout_highlights.title: Mouse's Warframe Experience
standout_highlights.description: Mouse shares that they started playing Warframe around December last year, have accumulated about 200 offline hours, and still consider themselves a 'baby Tenno,' despite others suggesting otherwise.

standout_highlights.title: Busy Schedule and Voice Preservation
standout_highlights.description: Mouse details a packed schedule including concerts, an anniversary, and a Subathon, explaining that this is why they haven't done many karaoke streams. They elaborate on their technique for screaming and talking without hurting their throat, attributing it to lessons learned in school.

standout_highlights.title: Viewer's Extensive Warframe Playtime
standout_highlights.description: A viewer comments on being 'burnt out on Warframe' despite being a founder with an impressive '3,263 hours' logged in the game.

standout_highlights.title: Bizarre Overheard Comment
standout_highlights.description: The streamer accidentally overhears someone's private conversation, specifically the line, 'I've got a picture of that girl's ass on my phone,' causing a startled reaction.

standout_highlights.title: Camera Awareness Check
standout_highlights.description: Following the overheard comment, the streamer humorously questions if they were supposed to hear that and if people around them are aware the camera is on.

standout_highlights.title: Discovery of Zombie Golf Game
standout_highlights.description: The streamer reads about a newly released 'Friends slob game,' 'Left or Dead Zombie Battle Golf,' described as a chaotic multiplayer golf game where zombies appear and friends make everything worse, sparking interest.

standout_highlights.title: Fan Interaction - Carousel Horse Girls
standout_highlights.description: The streamer warmly interacts with a group of fans present at the event, identified as 'the girls from Anime Los Angeles' and 'carousel horse girls,' who have gifted subs and mention a gift for the streamer in Power World.

standout_highlights.title: Personal Mental Health Update
standout_highlights.description: The streamer shares a candid moment, admitting that their mental health is 'not good right now' due to feeling sick and 'post-AX sadness,' but expresses hope to be okay.

standout_highlights.title: Anticipation for Normal Streaming Schedule
standout_highlights.description: The streamer expresses relief and anticipation for returning to their regular streaming schedule after the current event, stating, 'After this, I'm back to normal streaming time. Thank goodness.'

standout_highlights.title: Lucky Clover Gift
standout_highlights.description: A viewer named 'Iron Mouse' greets the streamer, claiming to be their lucky clover, and thanks them for a gift which included a lucky coin.

standout_highlights.title: Mom Check-up
standout_highlights.description: The streamer quickly announces a need to check on their mom, reassuring chat she is okay shortly after.

standout_highlights.title: Twitch Drop Glitch
standout_highlights.description: The streamer notes that Twitch is incorrectly showing a drop notification for Marvel Rivals, indicating a glitch.

standout_highlights.title: Tennocon Welcome
standout_highlights.description: Sheldon Carter, President of Digital Extremes, welcomes everyone to Tenno Live, expressing gratitude for the community and staff.

standout_highlights.title: Rebecca Ford's Recovery
standout_highlights.description: Sheldon Carter announces that Creative Director Rebecca Ford had a successful medical procedure and leads the audience in a recovery song for her.

standout_highlights.title: Tennocon Panel Introductions
standout_highlights.description: Sheldon introduces the panel members: Pablo, Jeff Brooks, Megan Everett, and Steve Sinclair, highlighting their roles and contributions.

standout_highlights.title: Emotional Reaction to Song
standout_highlights.description: The panelists note that Megan Everett was touched by the audience's recovery song for Rebecca, mentioning she was 'breaking backstage'.

standout_highlights.title: Record Attendance
standout_highlights.description: The panelists celebrate the 11th Tenno Live with record-breaking attendance and the unlocking of a new location due to the large crowd.

standout_highlights.title: Twitch Chat Reactions
standout_highlights.description: Hosts check Twitch chat, noting funny comments like 'Climp' and 'free Warframe,' with Rebecca clearing her throat playfully in response to the latter.

standout_highlights.title: Community & Charity Thank You
standout_highlights.description: A sincere thank you to the community for their support of Tennocon, Warframe, and Soulframe, which enables support for charity beneficiaries like Systemma and London Cares.

standout_highlights.title: In-Game Relay & Warframe Demo
standout_highlights.description: Announcement of the live in-game relay for the Warframe demo on Saturday, instructing players to visit the dry dock's 'right side' for a special experience, with a replay scheduled for next week.

standout_highlights.title: Uber Driver Misunderstanding
standout_highlights.description: A humorous story about an Uber driver thinking the event was for GTA 6, to which the host jokingly retorted, 'except we actually release.'

standout_highlights.title: Soulframe Dev Stream: Fishing
standout_highlights.description: Discussion about the Soulframe dev stream, humorously noting that players wanted fishing, leading to a comment that it's 'finally a real game now.'

standout_highlights.title: Soulframe Dev Stream: Mounts
standout_highlights.description: Details on the introduction of mounts in Soulframe, with a player stating they would 'come back' to the game for them, alongside mention of co-op support.

standout_highlights.title: Soulframe: New Boss & Free Weekend
standout_highlights.description: Announcement of a new sub-boss, the 'Menac rider,' and a free weekend for Soulframe Preludes, encouraging sign-ups and wishlisting.

standout_highlights.title: Last Year's Demo & This Year's Context
standout_highlights.description: A callback to last year's bizarre demo involving 'a rat being farted out the back end of a bear,' contrasting it with this year's Soulframe demo focus on the player's susceptibility to environmental pollution.

standout_highlights.title: Soulframe Live Demo Start
standout_highlights.description: The live Soulframe demo begins, with hosts reacting to surreal in-game text and visuals as the character wakes up, including phrases like 'Pregnant baby, huh?' and 'Panties.'

standout_highlights.title: Outfit Color Customization
standout_highlights.description: Reacting to an in-game outfit, the streamer expresses a strong desire for 'Pink and pink. Yes. Pink and pink. Pink and pink.'

standout_highlights.title: Bizarre Game Narration
standout_highlights.description: Commenting on the game's ominous dialogue: 'They say a searing spider in the ear, a ceiling slug in the throat.'

standout_highlights.title: The Master Beaver
standout_highlights.description: A new character is introduced, leading to the confused and humorous question: 'Are we the beaver? Baby beaver. We are beaver. Oh, our leg got the beaver's leg. Beaver. Beaver. Beaver. Beaver. Master Beaver.'

standout_highlights.title: Spanked Beaver
standout_highlights.description: Further commentary on the beaver character: 'Bro, that beaver got huge. Oh, a bent waggy. Who'd want such a thing? Bieber's alive and Bieber has a handprint on his butt. No, no. Off you go for more. Like he's been spanked.'

standout_highlights.title: Shrek Reference
standout_highlights.description: Identifying a character: 'Wait, it's that guy. this is my swamp. Goats.'

standout_highlights.title: Pennywise Reference
standout_highlights.description: Mimicking the famous line: 'You'll float too. You'll float too. You'll float too.'

standout_highlights.title: Rick and Morty Nipple War Tangent
standout_highlights.description: The streamer makes a 'stupid' connection: 'Do you guys remember that episode of Rick and Morty where he goes to that planet and he's like dating this entity that like makes the whole planet into a hive mine. And it was because the planet was in a war because they had like two different sets of nipples. I don't know why this made me think about it with a different color arm.'

standout_highlights.title: Old School Camera View
standout_highlights.description: Commenting on the game's visual style: 'Oh, it's Old school camera pointed at the screen. We're at the venue. I'm sorry. We're at the venue, bro.'

standout_highlights.title: Repetitive Doors
standout_highlights.description: A humorous complaint about game design: 'Oh my god. Can we have a little bit of variety with the doors?'

standout_highlights.title: Boss Fight & Orphan of Sugar
standout_highlights.description: The streamer references a difficult boss fight, humorously comparing it to 'Orphan of Sugar' (likely Orphan of Kos from Bloodborne), and discusses the impossibility of beating such a foe.

standout_highlights.title: Horse Mechanics & Running People Over
standout_highlights.description: A comedic reaction to in-game horse mechanics, with the streamer exclaiming 'My horse. I'm sold. I am headed for stupid' and jokingly admitting a fondness for 'running people over with a horse.'

standout_highlights.title: Bizarre 'War Songs' Clip Begins
standout_highlights.description: The start of a confusing and intense pre-recorded lore segment, introduced by cryptic lines like 'Never told you, did he? How she died? Shh. Listen.' marking the beginning of the 'War Songs quest' recap.

standout_highlights.title: DE as a Music Company
standout_highlights.description: After a segment of the confusing clip, the streamer comments, 'TE really is a music company that occasionally makes games, bro. I'm telling you, what an incredible record label,' suggesting the game's developer (Digital Extremes) is more known for its music.

standout_highlights.title: Confused Reaction to Clip: Duck Rhythm Game
standout_highlights.description: A bewildered reaction to the ongoing lore clip, questioning, 'Guys, are we the bad guys? All the birds are Whoa. What the crazy crazy duck rhythm game,' highlighting the clip's bizarre nature.

standout_highlights.title: What is Vegan Fishing?
standout_highlights.description: The streamer expresses humorous confusion over a detail in the lore clip, asking, 'What the [__] does vegan fishing mean? Is it catch and release? Is that what it is?'

standout_highlights.title: Emotionally Shattered by Clip
standout_highlights.description: The streamer concisely summarizes their profound reaction to the intense and confusing 'War Songs' lore segment, stating, 'Emotionally shattered,' indicating a need for a break.

standout_highlights.title: Rebecca Ford in the Box Joke
standout_highlights.description: A lighthearted joke during the giveaway setup, hoping for a popular personality, Rebecca Ford, to pop out of the themed prize box: 'Is Rebecca in there? Oh my god. Please. That'd be so cool if she popped out.'

standout_highlights.title: Bizarre Giveaway Query
standout_highlights.description: During the in-person giveaway, a strange and potentially misheard query is made: 'Do I see the Indian males or the dogs? No dogs. No dogs. Sure. You sure? I'm sure. Okay. Indians.'

standout_highlights.title: Wish for Eye Mouse Push
standout_highlights.description: A hopeful remark about potential future game announcements during the giveaways: 'What if they just pulled out an eye mouse push and said, 'This is something we got in the works.' I wish.'

standout_highlights.title: Goat Gun Winner
standout_highlights.description: An amusing moment during the giveaway as a winner with a memorable name is announced: 'Goat gun. Gun. We have a goat gun in the house.'

standout_highlights.title: Giveaway Winner
standout_highlights.description: All right, my last prize. This is one, the only Lety and Air flu. Anybody get these this weekend? ... Tali Lolo.

standout_highlights.title: Zach's Cardio
standout_highlights.description: Zach is getting some cardio.

standout_highlights.title: Get Soaked Joke
standout_highlights.description: Oh my god. Get soaked. Is that what she says? Get soaked.

standout_highlights.title: Toilet Rewards
standout_highlights.description: Toilet rewards are coming.

standout_highlights.title: Team No Duster Debate
standout_highlights.description: Oh, team no duster.

standout_highlights.title: Ben Starr's Eyeliner
standout_highlights.description: I did change. I still wasn't able to get the eyeliner off.

standout_highlights.title: Lying to Fortnite Community
standout_highlights.description: for six months of the year, I lied to them and I said, I'm this guy called the Visitor. But I'm not going to lie to you. My true community, my Warframe community.

standout_highlights.title: Excalibur Coming to Fortnite (Comedic)
standout_highlights.description: it only feels right that I get the opportunity to announce that Excalibur is coming to Fortnite.

standout_highlights.title: Wear My Skin
standout_highlights.description: I would love it if you wear my skin. I want every single one of you to wear my skin and wear it with glee.

standout_highlights.title: Learning The Gritty
standout_highlights.description: Can I be fully transparent? I didn't know what the gritty was until 24 hours ago. I've had to look at a guy who apparently invented it and watch it on YouTube.

standout_highlights.title: Ben Starr Hits The Gritty
standout_highlights.description: [applause] Yeah. Thank you so much.

standout_highlights.title: Excalibur in Fortnite (Actual Collaboration)
standout_highlights.description: He was hitting the grid way in the Epic game store. If you want to purchase Warframe packs, you can get Excalibur for free in Fortnite.

standout_highlights.title: Visitor and Excalibur Kissing
standout_highlights.description: You're Is The Visitor and Excalibur going to hit the gritty? Yeah, they'll kiss or something. I don't probably someone draw some artwork of that or something for me.

standout_highlights.title: Air Hacked The Airwaves
standout_highlights.description: For those of you that don't know, Air has hacked the highway. What am I trying to say? Airwaves. Thank you.

standout_highlights.title: Themed Nightwave Featuring Air
standout_highlights.description: And in August, you're going to get a skinned a themed Nightwave featuring air.

standout_highlights.title: New Female Ice Warframe
standout_highlights.description: Hosts discuss a new female ice Warframe coming in the 'Ice Blade of Narin' update, with an excited, joking shout-out to 'ice wall' and 'females'.

standout_highlights.title: Banshee Deluxe & Rework
standout_highlights.description: The Banshee Deluxe, conceptualized by artist Mishka, is revealed, followed by the announcement of an upcoming Banshee rework intended to make her existing strong kit more accessible to players.

standout_highlights.title: Global Tour Announcements
standout_highlights.description: Warframe's upcoming travel plans for the year are unveiled, including visits to South Korea (Seoul for the September dev stream), China, London (UK), and Glasgow.

standout_highlights.title: Jeff Joins the Girls
standout_highlights.description: Jeff is humorously included in the South Korea trip by the host stating, 'He's one of the girls,' eliciting laughter.

standout_highlights.title: Tennocon 2025 Dates
standout_highlights.description: The official dates for next year's Tennocon are announced as July 16th and 17th, met with cheers from the audience.

standout_highlights.title: Matt Mercer as Brisco
standout_highlights.description: Renowned voice actor Matt Mercer is announced as joining the Warframe family, voicing the new character 'Brisco,' described as a detective, sparking discussion on how this will integrate with non-speaking Warframes.

standout_highlights.title: Rebecca Ford's Dedication
standout_highlights.description: The hosts acknowledge the immense hard work put into the upcoming demo by the development team, specifically highlighting Rebecca Ford ('Space Mom') for working on it until the very last day.

standout_highlights.title: Space Mom's Teaser Message
standout_highlights.description: A pre-recorded message from Rebecca Ford sets the stage for the live demo, teasing specific directions for the Warframe story and a live in-game moment for players in the relay.

standout_highlights.title: Secret Agent Spy Excitement
standout_highlights.description: The VTuber exclaims, "Oh my god, we're like super secret agent spy," reacting to dialogue in the trailer about covert operations.

standout_highlights.title: New Detective Warframe Revealed
standout_highlights.description: The VTuber enthusiastically identifies the new character as a "new detective themed Warframe. Not a photo frame, but a Chimera frame."

standout_highlights.title: Brisco's 'Nice Ass'
standout_highlights.description: Admiration for the new Warframe's design, with the VTuber noting, "Chimera frame. Ow. Got a nice ass."

standout_highlights.title: Smoking Detective Coolness
standout_highlights.description: Upon seeing the character smoke, the VTuber screams, "Oh my god, he's so cool. Look at him smoking. [screaming]" highlighting their strong positive reaction.

standout_highlights.title: Hardboiled Detective Archetype
standout_highlights.description: The VTuber perfectly summarizes the character's aesthetic, declaring him "The hardboiled detective, I tell you."

standout_highlights.title: Game is Free?
standout_highlights.description: Reacting to the quality and depth of the trailer, the VTuber questions, "This is so cool. All dreaming are dead until the rains come. And this game is free. What the heck?" in disbelief.

standout_highlights.title: Brisco: I Need Him Now
standout_highlights.description: Expressing intense desire for the new character, the VTuber says, "I [__] love him. Mindless, heartless, dead, Brisco. I love you, bro. I need him. I need him now."

standout_highlights.title: Gambling Machine Frenzy
standout_highlights.description: The VTuber reacts with repeated screams and exclamations to a scene in the trailer featuring a gambling machine: "Oh [screaming] my god. Gabbling. Gabby gambling. Gibbly gambling. Gibbly gambling. [screaming] What? Oh my god. [screaming]"

standout_highlights.title: Trailer's Awesome Impact
standout_highlights.description: Overwhelmed by the trailer's content, the VTuber simply states, "Holy [__] This is awesome."

standout_highlights.title: Batman Gami?
standout_highlights.description: Confused and amused by a character's dialogue or appearance near the end of the trailer, the VTuber asks, "Bro, what the [__] And he's like, 'Gami like is Batman Gami?'"

standout_highlights.title: Cinematic Reaction & 'How is this game free?'
standout_highlights.description: The streamer reacts with intense excitement to the dramatic cinematic, exclaiming 'This is what Albert wanted. A place at the hunger's table.' and questioning the game's free-to-play model due to the high production quality: 'How is this game free?'

standout_highlights.title: Desire to Cover Music
standout_highlights.description: Upon hearing the background music in the cinematic, the streamer immediately expresses a desire to cover it: 'Bro, we need a mouse cover. I was just going to say, now I have to cover this song.'

standout_highlights.title: Casino Reveal Excitement
standout_highlights.description: The revelation of a new casino-themed area within the cinematic causes the streamer to scream in delight, expressing a strong desire to explore it: 'Oh my god. I want to hang out in here all the time. This is insane.'

standout_highlights.title: Confused Reaction to Villain Monologue
standout_highlights.description: A villain's ominous monologue about 'torturing your kind' and making 'wagers on how long you could endure' leaves the streamer perplexed and shocked: 'Oh my god. What the [ __ ] did that mean?'

standout_highlights.title: Bizarre On-Screen Observation
standout_highlights.description: Reacting to a visual element in the cinematic, the streamer makes a humorous and somewhat bizarre observation: 'That looks like a little poop, but it's not. It's a finger.'

standout_highlights.title: Major 'Going to Town' Reveal Celebration
standout_highlights.description: The climax of the cinematic reveals a long-awaited new hub area, sparking an ecstatic and celebratory reaction from the streamer: 'Guys, guys, guys, we're going to town. We're going to towel. Finally. 13 years. We're going to towel.'

standout_highlights.title: New Area and 'Steel Path' Reference
standout_highlights.description: During the developer discussion of the new 'town' area, the streamer wonders about game mechanics in the new space, specifically referencing a high-difficulty mode: 'cuz steel path can't exist there.'

standout_highlights.title: Thanking the Bus Driver Meme
standout_highlights.description: Following the demo, a panelist invokes a popular community meme by saying: 'Thank the bus driver. We thank the bus driver.'

standout_highlights.title: Post-Show Summary: 'Absolute Cinema'
standout_highlights.description: After the presentation concludes, the streamer summarizes the entire experience with high praise: 'Well, that was absolute cinema. That was absolute cinema for sure.'

standout_highlights.title: Warframe Strippers
standout_highlights.description: The streamer reacts with laughter to a bizarre chat comment about 'Warframe strippers'.

standout_highlights.title: Best Gaming Community
standout_highlights.description: The streamer declares Warframe has one of the best gaming communities, highlighting its welcoming nature even more so than Final Fantasy.

standout_highlights.title: Aggressively Wholesome
standout_highlights.description: The Warframe community is described as 'aggressively wholesome' and praised for being so welcoming.

standout_highlights.title: Keeping Secrets
standout_highlights.description: The streamer praises the Warframe community for being exceptionally good at keeping story secrets, ensuring no spoilers for new players.

standout_highlights.title: Dojo Casino and Ferris Wheel
standout_highlights.description: The streamer playfully suggests adding a casino and a ferris wheel to the Warframe dojo.

standout_highlights.title: Warframe Dating Sim
standout_highlights.description: In response to chat, the streamer humorously remarks, 'Sex in Warframe one. We have enough of that already. Dad, behave. We already got a dating sim.'

standout_highlights.title: FaZe Ben Star for Money
standout_highlights.description: The streamer makes a humorous observation about FaZe Ben Star, saying, 'Fa Ben Star will do anything for money. And I love him for it.'

standout_highlights.title: Mousy A3 Quote
standout_highlights.description: A notable TTS message from chat says, 'Mousy A3, I'll show you a finger.'

The streamer shares a candid moment, admitting that their mental health is 'not good right now' due to feeling sick and 'post-AX sadness,' but expresses hope to be okay.
The streamer expresses relief and anticipation for returning to their regular streaming schedule after the current event, stating, 'After this, I'm back to normal streaming time. Thank goodness.'

chunks.summary:
The segment begins with the streamer discussing a 'new Ghost Show' and its accuracy to the manga, then quickly shifts to checking for Steam controller order notifications. Shortly after, the streamer interacts with a viewer named 'Iron Mouse' who claims to be their 'lucky clover' and thanks them for a gift, which includes a lucky coin. There's a brief mention of prizes for 'Rob' and a quick check-up on the streamer's mom. The stream then experiences a Twitch glitch showing a Marvel Rivals drop notification incorrectly. 

The focus transitions to what appears to be a live event, Tennocon, with Iron Mouse greeting someone, noting the large crowd, and hearing people running. Sheldon Carter, the President of Digital Extremes, officially welcomes everyone to Tenno Live. Sheldon then leads the entire audience in a modified 'Happy Birthday' song, singing 'Happy recovery to you, all the Tenno miss you, we love you, hope you feel better soon' for Rebecca. Following this touching moment, Sheldon introduces the panel members: Pablo (Director of Warframe's design), Jeff Brooks (Creative Director of Soulframe), Megan Everett (who keeps the panel and community under control), and Steve Sinclair (DE's fearless leader). The panel then takes over, expressing gratitude for the community's support over 11 years and celebrating record-breaking attendance at Tennocon, with a tease about Brian Alex (a Canadian) appearing next month.

chunks.summary: The segment begins with the hosts apologizing for being 'uncult' and quickly transitions into housekeeping announcements before the main event. They check Twitch chat, noting humorous comments like 'Climp' and 'free Warframe.' A heartfelt thank you is extended to the community for supporting Tennocon, Warframe, and Soulframe, highlighting the ability to support charities like Systemma and London Cares. chunks.summary: The streamer spends the segment reacting to what appears to be a cinematic game trailer or cutscene, offering live commentary and often bizarre interpretations. The segment begins with comments on an in-game outfit, expressing a desire for color customization, specifically pink and gold. This quickly transitions into reacting to dramatic boss fight narration, featuring unsettling descriptions like 'a searing spider in the ear, a ceiling slug in the throat,' and references to magical singing. A strange 'Master Beaver' character appears, which is later observed to have grown 'huge' and sport a 'handprint on his butt,' leading to the humorous conclusion that 'he's been spanked' and must now 'bake a cake.' chunks.summary: The segment begins with a discussion about a difficult boss fight, referencing 'Orphan of Sugar' (likely Orphan of Kos from Bloodborne) and a humorous take on in-game horse mechanics. This quickly transitions into a lengthy, highly confusing, and emotionally intense pre-recorded segment, later identified as a condensed version of the 'War Songs quest' from the game Warframe. This clip features cryptic dialogue, bizarre scenarios like a 'duck rhythm game,' 'vegan fishing,' and 'edge lord wolf packs,' leaving the streamer 'emotionally shattered' and prompting commentary that the game's developer (Digital Extremes) seems more like a music company than a game developer. After recovering from the clip, the stream moves into a lively giveaway session for both online and in-person attendees. Several 100,000 Platinum prizes are distributed to online viewers (e.g., toxic_J) and in-person winners (e.g., Onion aid, Angry Screech). Physical prizes, including a Nidus statue and a 7-piece dice set signed by Rebecca Ford, are also given away, with one winner humorously named 'Goat gun.' The giveaways involve DE volunteer runners to assist with the process at what appears to be a live event, accompanied by jokes about popular personality Rebecca Ford popping out of a prize box.

chunks.summary: The stream segment began with the hosts wrapping up a giveaway for 'Letty and Air,' with Tali Lolo being announced as the winner, followed by playful remarks about a co-host, Zach, getting cardio. They then moved into a series of announcements, starting with the return of the 'Dog Days' soccer event on August 4th, which prompted humorous discussion about 'getting soaked.' New glyphs designed by Space Waifu were revealed, alongside a mention of 'toilet rewards,' and the hosts highlighted the arrow glyph as a favorite. A significant part of the segment was dedicated to showcasing a new heirloom (implied to be Mesa Prime), designed by Liger, which had just gone live, leading to a lighthearted debate about 'team no duster' regarding the character's design. The main highlight was the comedic appearance of voice actor Ben Starr, introduced as 'Arthur Nightingale.' Starr, who had previously dressed as Rebecca Ford and still had eyeliner on, engaged in a humorous 'announcement.' He jokingly recounted his role as 'Jenno' (The Visitor) in Fortnite, claiming to have 'lied' to the Fortnite community for six months. He then dramatically 'revealed' that Excalibur from Warframe would be 'coming to Fortnite,' which was a self-referential joke about himself as The Visitor/Excalibur, encouraging viewers to 'wear my skin.' After some banter, he performed 'the gritty' dance, admitting he had only learned it 24 hours prior. The actual collaboration was then clarified: purchasing Warframe packs via the Epic Games Store would grant Excalibur for free in Fortnite, celebrating a long-standing partnership. Starr also briefly plugged his role as Bayor in Soulframe and encouraged viewers to play Warframe. The segment concluded with the announcement that Air would be featured in a themed Nightwave event in August, humorously framed as Air 'hacking the airwaves,' with hosts teasing unofficial skin ideas.

chunks.summary: This segment of the stream was packed with announcements regarding upcoming Warframe content and events. It kicked off with news about the 'Ice Blade of Narin' update, introducing a new female ice Warframe, Citrine Prime, Corvex Deluxe (gargoyle-themed), and a Banshee Deluxe. A significant highlight was the discussion around a planned rework for Banshee, aimed at making her powerful kit more accessible to a wider player base, as she's currently considered very strong but difficult to master. Following the in-game updates, the hosts detailed Warframe's global tour for the rest of the year, including visits to South Korea (hosting the September dev stream), China, London, and Glasgow, with a humorous mention of Jeff being 'one of the girls' for the Seoul trip. The segment also revealed the official dates for next year's Tennocon: July 16th and 17th. The anticipation built towards a live demo, featuring a major announcement: renowned voice actor Matt Mercer is joining the Warframe family to voice the new character 'Brisco,' described as a detective, sparking curiosity about how a non-speaking Warframe will incorporate a voice. The segment concluded with heartfelt thanks to the development team, particularly Rebecca Ford ('Space Mom'), for her tireless work on the demo. A pre-recorded message from Rebecca, who couldn't be present, teased the future direction of the Warframe story and an upcoming live in-game event for players in the relay.

The Banshee Deluxe, conceptualized by artist Mishka, is revealed, followed by the announcement of an upcoming Banshee rework intended to make her existing strong kit more accessible to players.
Warframe's upcoming travel plans for the year are unveiled, including visits to South Korea (Seoul for the September dev stream), China, London (UK), and Glasgow.

The official dates for next year's Tennocon are announced as July 16th and 17th, met with cheers from the audience.

The hosts acknowledge the immense hard work put into the upcoming demo by the development team, specifically highlighting Rebecca Ford ('Space Mom') for working on it until the very last day.
A pre-recorded message from Rebecca Ford sets the stage for the live demo, teasing specific directions for the Warframe story and a live in-game moment for players in the relay.

chunks.summary: This segment captures the VTuber's live reaction to a significant portion of a Warframe Tennocon presentation. The stream begins with a dramatic cinematic reveal for a new expansion, featuring intense dialogue, a mysterious 'devil' figure, and a new location that appears to be a high-stakes casino. The streamer is incredibly hyped throughout, screaming in excitement and disbelief at the visuals and story unfolding. The cinematic culminates in a reveal of a major new hub area, referred to as 'town' or 'tow,' which has been a long-awaited feature for 13 years by the community. Following the cinematic, Warframe developers, including Rebecca, discuss the development process of this new content, mentioning its early conceptualization in 2024 under the name 'Frisco' and outlining plans for new missions, mission types, and a brand new solar system. They emphasize the team's hard work and express immense gratitude to the Tenno community for their energy and support. The presentation concludes with emotional thanks from the developers. The streamer then transitions back to interacting with chat, still buzzing from the 'absolute cinema' experience and excitedly reiterating the 'going to town' reveal, while also thanking a donator.

A villain's ominous monologue about 'torturing your kind' and making 'wagers on how long you could endure' leaves the streamer perplexed and shocked: 'Oh my god. What the [ __ ] did that mean?'
Reacting to a visual element in the cinematic, the streamer makes a humorous and somewhat bizarre observation: 'That looks like a little poop, but it's not. It's a finger.'

The climax of the cinematic reveals a long-awaited new hub area, sparking an ecstatic and celebratory reaction from the streamer: 'Guys, guys, guys, we're going to town. We're going to towel. Finally. 13 years. We're going to towel.'

During the developer discussion of the new 'town' area, the streamer wonders about game mechanics in the new space, specifically referencing a high-difficulty mode: 'cuz steel path can't exist there.'
Following the demo, a panelist invokes a popular community meme by saying: 'Thank the bus driver. We thank the bus driver.'
After the presentation concludes, the streamer summarizes the entire experience with high praise: 'Well, that was absolute cinema. That was absolute cinema for sure.'

chunks.summary: The stream segment opens with the streamer acknowledging gifted subscriptions before reacting to a chat comment about 'Warframe strippers.' This quickly transitions into a heartfelt recap of their first Tennocon experience, expressing immense gratitude to Digital Extremes and everyone who facilitated their attendance. The streamer emphasizes having fallen deeply in love with Warframe and her desire to attend future Tennocons, also mentioning interest in Soulframe. A significant portion of the segment is dedicated to praising the Warframe community, which she declares as one of the best gaming communities she's ever encountered, describing them as 'aggressively wholesome' and even more welcoming than the Final Fantasy community. She highlights their impressive ability to keep story secrets, ensuring a spoiler-free experience for new players. After thanking Anarchy for a raid and reflecting on Warframe's cinematic story, the streamer engages in playful banter with chat, suggesting adding a casino and a ferris wheel to the Warframe dojo, and humorously deflecting a 'sex in Warframe' comment by saying the game already has a 'dating sim.' The streamer then reveals she has been sick for the past week and mentions FaZe Ben Star's willingness to do anything for money. The segment concludes with her announcing an upcoming quick interview with GDQ and outlining her busy streaming schedule for the coming week, including an Anime Impulse concert on Saturday, while apologizing for the recent shorter streams.
